title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover to prevent capacity thrashing
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Recent incident (SUP-1221) showed SLO enforcer's aggressive immediate retries and shallow backoff coupled with regional failover caused capacity thrashing across regions during a degraded node pool event. This hotfix tightens the enforcer backoff algorithm, adds a jittered exponential backoff cap, and introduces a conservative regional-failover cooldown to avoid cascade failovers. Motivation: reduce cross-region failovers and stabilize load-shedding decisions so customer traffic degrades gracefully without oscillation. Changes: 1) SLO enforcer: increase default backoff base to 500ms, apply jitter (+/-20%), exponential multiplier up to 8x, and a fixed cooldown window per region (30s) before triggering failover again. 2) Circuit breaker: add an intermediate 'throttle' state that transitions before full open; throttle reduces accepted concurrency by 50% and synthesizes 503 responses with Retry-After when capacity low. 3) Load shedding: prefer prefix/KV cache reuse threshold heuristics to reject expensive long-context requests when tail-latency is high. 4) Regional failover policy: only failover to secondary region if region's sustained error rate > 20% for 15s and region capacity < 60% for 10s; otherwise escalate to operator alert. 5) Observability: new metrics (slo_enforcer.backoff_ms, slo_enforcer.cooldown_active, regional_failover.attempts) and dashboards updated. Rollout: staged canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on regression. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for backoff math and throttle state - [x] Integration test simulating regional node pool outage - [x] Load test at 2x baseline to validate no thrashing - [x] Docs update for failover config flags - [x] Verified canary and gradual rollout

release_notes: Hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff, throttle circuit-breaker state, conservative regional failover and load-shedding heuristics. Reduces cross-region failovers and improves stability during node pool degradation. Config flags: slo_enforcer.backoff_base_ms, slo_enforcer.backoff_multiplier, slo_enforcer.cooldown_seconds, regional_failover.min_error_rate, regional_failover.capacity_threshold.

changelog_entry: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer to prevent regional thrashing; added throttle state and cooldown for failovers.
risk_assessment: Low-Medium: changes are restricted to enforcer and failover policy with feature flags and staged rollout. Observability added to detect regressions.
test_summary: Unit: 28 tests added. Integration: regional outage scenario validated. Load: 2x baseline run showed stable regional failure rate and no oscillation. E2E: Retry-After header propagation validated across SDKs.
additional_context: This change was motivated by a P0 incident where simultaneous autoscaler events in us-east-1 caused transient capacity drops. The previous aggressive immediate retries and naive failover logic caused most traffic to move to secondary regions and then back, causing oscillation. The fix focuses on graceful degradation and conservative failover with operator escalation in ambiguous cases.
